title: Suite marker 1.0.0
description: Committed at the repository root as `.ai-engineering-suite.json`. Its presence is the project's opt-in and the only signal enforcement reads: without it every gate command allows and prints nothing that blocks.

dimensions.description: `all` registers every member of the manifest; a list registers exactly those dimension identifiers.

evidenceRoot.description: Overrides the default evidence root. `~` expands to the user's home directory. A relative path resolves against the repository root, which the change set then excludes.

exportDirectory.description: Repository-relative directory `export` writes to. Excluded from the change set and from every fingerprint.

ignore.description: Repository-relative glob patterns removed from the change set. `*` matches within one segment, `**` across segments.

base.description: Default comparison base when a declaration names none.

conflictRoundCap.description: Consecutive cross-dimension conflict rounds before `can-review` is refused with `arbitration-required`.

roundCap.description: Total review rounds for one task before completion ends with `round-cap-reached`.

allowReplay.description: `false` forbids the gate-executed replay remedy, leaving a rerun of a full cycle as the only remedy for chronology-bound evidence.

requireVerifiedIdentity.description: `true` refuses an attestation stored `identity-unverified`, for harnesses that provide agent identifiers.
